title: UK universities face ‘financial crisis’ amid collapse in international students

paragraphs.en: University leaders are warning of financial turmoil in British higher education after new figures suggested a collapse in international student numbers would deprive the sector of vital income and undermine its future.
paragraphs.zh: 大学领导人正在就英国高等教育的财务动荡发出警告，因为最新数据显示，国际学生人数骤降将使该行业失去关键收入，并损害其未来。

paragraphs.en: The sector’s leaders called on the government to rethink the levy on international student fees imposed under Keir Starmer, as a former universities minister warned there was a risk of a university “going under” because of the financial crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 该行业的领导人呼吁政府重新考虑在基尔·斯塔默（Keir Starmer）领导下对国际学生学费征收的附加费，与此同时，一位前大学事务大臣警告称，存在大学因这场财务危机而“倒闭”的风险。

paragraphs.en: While UK sixth-formers enjoyed improved A-level results , and a record 194,800 English 18-year-olds were accepted by their first choice of university, vice-chancellors who spoke to the Guardian said it would not be enough to stave off further erosion in staff numbers and courses.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管英国的六年级学生们取得了更好的 A-level 成绩，且创纪录的 19.48 万名英格兰 18 岁青年被第一志愿大学录取，但接受《卫报》采访的大学副校长们表示，这不足以阻止教职员工人数和课程数量进一步萎缩。

paragraphs.en: Related: Students face ‘ticking timebomb’ of debt and higher taxes
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：学生面临债务与高税率的“定时炸弹”

paragraphs.en: Figures published by the Home Office show student visa applications to the end of July fell 11% compared with the previous year. With summer visa applications coming before the start of the academic year in autumn, the gloomy figures mean many UK universities will experience significant losses if the trend continues, with some fearing international enrolments dropping by 30%.
paragraphs.zh: 英国内政部（Home Office）公布的数据显示，截至 7 月底的学生签证申请量与去年同期相比下降了 11%。由于暑期签证申请发生在秋季学年开始之前，这些黯淡的数据意味着，如果这一趋势持续下去，许多英国大学将遭受重大损失，一些院校担心国际学生入学人数将下降 30%。

paragraphs.en: Prof Shitij Kapur, the vice-chancellor of King’s College London, said the fall in international student numbers was “in line with the pessimistic expectations” and may also reflect a drop in postgraduate applications earlier this year.
paragraphs.zh: 伦敦国王学院（King's College London）副校长希蒂吉·卡普尔（Shitij Kapur）教授表示，国际学生人数的下降“符合悲观预期”，可能也反映了今年早些时候研究生申请数量的下滑。

paragraphs.en: Kapur said: “The critical thing is what this cycle will entail, which does not become clear till about October. The simple rubric is that every five international students impact one university job. And these falling numbers will invariably impact the financial health and staff complement of universities.
paragraphs.zh: 卡普尔说：“关键在于这个周期会带来什么影响，而这要到 10 月左右才会明朗。简单的规律是，每五名国际学生就对应大学的一个工作岗位。而这些不断下降的人数，必然会影响大学的财务健康状况和人员配置。”

paragraphs.en: “The silver lining in this gloomy picture is that the strength and desire to go to universities amongst our school leavers remains as strong as ever despite concerns about the loan schemes and graduate jobs, as you can see today.”
paragraphs.zh: “在这幅黯淡图景中，一线希望在于，尽管人们对贷款计划和毕业生就业感到担忧，但我们的离校生对大学的热情和向往仍一如既往地强烈，正如你今天所看到的那样。”
